Message.Name: Login Message
Message.Description: The Login message is sent by the trading Member as the initial message used to establish a trading session

Field.Name: protocolVersion
Field.Description: Version of the protocol being used

Field.Name: senderID
Field.Description: Value as agreed with Aquis to identify the Member’s ATP session

Field.Name: password
Field.Description: Password as agreed with Aquis to verify the user

Field.Name: atpSeqNo
Field.Description: The next sequence number that the trading Member is expecting to receive on messages from Aquis

Message.Name: Login Response Message
Message.Description: The Login Response message is sent by Aquis to acknowledge a Login request, and either accept or reject it.

Field.Name: clientSeqNo
Field.Description: Next sequence number Aquis expects to receive

Message.Name: Heartbeat
Message.Description: A Heartbeat message is a message header with msgType set to 0 and msgSeqNo set to the sequence number of the next business message.

Message.Name: Logout Request Message
Message.Description: The Logout Request message is used by the trading Member to request the closure of a trading session.

Message.Name: Logout Message
Message.Description: The Logout message is usually sent as a response to the Logout Request. The TCP/IP connection is closed immediately after this message has been sent.

Message.Name: Order Add Message
Message.Description: The Order Add message is sent by the trading Member to enter an order for a particular security.

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: Limit price of the order; 0 for MaC orders

Field.Name: account
Field.Description: Clearing account identifier; 1 = House Account, 2 or above = agreed Client Account code

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag assigned by trading Member

Field.Name: tableSelect1
Field.Description: Party role qualifier and role for party 1

Field.Name: tableSelect2
Field.Description: Party role qualifier and role for party 2

Field.Name: tableSelect3
Field.Description: Party role qualifier and role for party 3

Message.Name: Order Add Extended Message
Message.Description: The Order Add Extended message is sent by the trading Member to enter an order for a particular security with additional attributes.

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: Limit price of the order; optional when OrderType=12, a value of 0 is interpreted as no limit price

Field.Name: account
Field.Description: Clearing account identifier; 1 = House Account, 2 or above = agreed Client Account code

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag assigned by trading Member

Field.Name: tableSelect1
Field.Description: Party role qualifier and role for party 1

Field.Name: tableSelect2
Field.Description: Party role qualifier and role for party 2

Field.Name: tableSelect3
Field.Description: Party role qualifier and role for party 3

Field.Name: displayQuantity
Field.Description: Display quantity for an iceberg order; set to 0 for non-iceberg orders

Field.Name: minQty
Field.Description: Minimum quantity of an order to be executed; 0 = no minimum quantity

Field.Name: DesignatedOrderId
Field.Description: The order ID of the contra as provided by OptimX; set to 0 if not applicable

Field.Name: PegDifference
Field.Description: Only applicable for AoD Near Touch Pegged orders; value added to the peg calculation

Message.Name: Order Cancel Message
Message.Description: The Order Cancel message is sent when a user wishes to cancel an open order.

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag assigned by trading Member

Field.Name: tableSelect1
Field.Description: Party role qualifier and role for party 1

Field.Name: tableSelect2
Field.Description: Party role qualifier and role for party 2

Field.Name: tableSelect3
Field.Description: Party role qualifier and role for party 3

Message.Name: Order Modify Message
Message.Description: The Order Modify message is sent when a user wishes to modify an open order. Order quantity and/or limit price may be modified. Both values must be included, even if one of them is unchanged.

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: The new price of the order

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag assigned by trading Member

Field.Name: tableSelect1
Field.Description: Party role qualifier and role for party 1

Field.Name: tableSelect2
Field.Description: Party role qualifier and role for party 2

Field.Name: tableSelect3
Field.Description: Party role qualifier and role for party 3

Message.Name: Order Modify Extended Message
Message.Description: The Order Modify Extended message is sent when a user wants to modify an open Order Add Extended. All values must be included, even if some are unchanged.

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: The new price of the order; when OrderType=12, a value of 0 is interpreted as no limit price

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: The new total order quantity (number of shares)

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag assigned by trading Member

Field.Name: tableSelect1
Field.Description: Party role qualifier and role for party 1

Field.Name: tableSelect2
Field.Description: Party role qualifier and role for party 2

Field.Name: tableSelect3
Field.Description: Party role qualifier and role for party 3

Field.Name: displayQuantity
Field.Description: New display quantity of the iceberg order

Field.Name: minQty
Field.Description: New minimum quantity (shares) of an order to be executed

Message.Name: Order Add Response Message
Message.Description: Aquis sends an Order Add Response message to acknowledge the receipt of an Order Add or an Order Add Extended message.

Field.Name: marketDataID
Field.Description: The ID of this order as seen in the Aquis market data; zero if the order is cancelled (IOC) or fully traded on entry

Field.Name: status
Field.Description: Status of order and reject or cancel code; first 3 most significant bits = order status, lower 5 bits = reason code

Field.Name: tradedQuantity
Field.Description: Number of shares traded, if any

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Time that the order was accepted or rejected by the Aquis system

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag as assigned by trading Member on the Order Add message

Message.Name: Order Cancel Response Message
Message.Description: Aquis sends an Order Cancel Response to accept or reject an Order Cancel message. The message is also used if an order is cancelled by Market Operations or due to cancel on disconnect.

Field.Name: requestRef
Field.Description: Sequence number of the trading Member's Order Cancel message; zero for forced cancels generated by Aquis or cancel messages from the MaC

Field.Name: status
Field.Description: Status of order and reject or cancel code; first 3 most significant bits = order status, lower 5 bits = reason code

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Time that the cancellation was accepted or rejected by the Aquis system

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag as assigned by trading Member on the Order Cancel message

Message.Name: Order Modify Response Message
Message.Description: Aquis sends an Order Modify Response to accept or reject an Order Modify or an Order Modify Extended message.

Field.Name: requestRef
Field.Description: Sequence number of the trading Member's Order Modify message

Field.Name: status
Field.Description: Status of order and reject or cancel code; first 3 most significant bits = order status, lower 5 bits = reason code

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Time that the modification was accepted or rejected by the Aquis system

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag as assigned by trading Member on the Order Modify message

Message.Name: Iceberg Order Refresh Message
Message.Description: Aquis sends an Iceberg Order Refresh message to notify the Member when an iceberg order is refreshed from the non-displayed reserve quantity.

Field.Name: origAqxOrdId
Field.Description: The ID of the original order as seen in the Aquis market data

Field.Name: newAqxOrdId
Field.Description: The ID of the iceberg order refresh as seen in the Aquis market data

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: Refreshed display quantity of the iceberg order

Message.Name: Trade Capture Message
Message.Description: Aquis uses a Trade Capture Report message for the purposes of allowing members to submit Large In Scale (LIS) and Benchmark Cross trades to the exchange.

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: The price at which the trade was crossed

Field.Name: account
Field.Description: Clearing account identifier; 1 = House Account, 2 or above = agreed Client Account code

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag as assigned by trading Member

Message.Name: Trade Capture Response Message
Message.Description: Aquis sends a Trade Capture Response Message to accept or reject a Trade Capture Message.

Field.Name: status
Field.Description: Status of order and reject or cancel code; first 3 most significant bits = order status, lower 5 bits = reason code

Field.Name: tradeRef
Field.Description: Trade reference number; corresponds to the TVTIC

Field.Name: requestRef
Field.Description: Sequence number of the trading Member's Trade Capture Message

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag as assigned by trading Member on the trade capture message

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: The Trade message is published by Aquis when an order executes. The Trade message is also used to communicate indicative trade reports at lock time for Market at Close orders, and matched firm VWAP orders beginning their crossing duration.

Field.Name: tradeRef
Field.Description: Trade reference number; corresponds to the TVTIC

Field.Name: ccpCode
Field.Description: Clearing CCP code; 1 = Self clearing, 2 and above = CCP code

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Time that the trade occurred on the Aquis system

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag as assigned by trading Member on the Order Add message or the most recent Order Modify message

Message.Name: Trade Bust Message
Message.Description: If a trade is invalidated, a Trade Bust message is sent to notify the trading Member.

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares on invalidated trade

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: The price of the invalidated trade

Field.Name: tradeRef
Field.Description: Trade reference number for the invalidated trade

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Time that the trade was busted by Aquis

Message.Name: IOI Add Message
Message.Description: IOI to send a conditional into the AMP or AVM. IOIs can be cancelled and modified using Order Modify and Order Cancel.

Field.Name: account
Field.Description: Clearing account identifier; 1 = House Account, 2 or above = agreed Client Account code

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag assigned by trading Member

Field.Name: tableSelect1
Field.Description: Party role qualifier and role for party 1

Field.Name: tableSelect2
Field.Description: Party role qualifier and role for party 2

Field.Name: tableSelect3
Field.Description: Party role qualifier and role for party 3

Field.Name: minQty
Field.Description: Minimum quantity of an order to be executed; 0 = no minimum quantity

Field.Name: BlotterBlacklist
Field.Description: 50 byte blacklist as agreed with OptimX

Message.Name: IOI Invite Message
Message.Description: Message from Aquis to the member indicating a firm up invite. The invite will expire 300ms after the value in the timestamp field.

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: Maximum quantity available to be traded

Field.Name: minQty
Field.Description: Minimum quantity that is needed for a trade to take place

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Time the IOI Invite was sent

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag assigned by trading Member

Message.Name: IOI Firmup Message
Message.Description: Firm up message to be used as a response to an invite.

Field.Name: minQty
Field.Description: Minimum quantity of an order to be executed; 0 = no minimum quantity

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag assigned by trading Member

Field.Name: stpEnable
Field.Description: Self-trade prevention; only valid when OrderType=12; 0 = No restriction, 1 = Enabled

Field.Name: lisOnly
Field.Description: LIS executions only; only valid when OrderType=12; 0 = No restriction, 1 = LIS executions only

Field.Name: Routetolit
Field.Description: Route to Lit; 0 = Order is not routed, 1 = Route to Lit

Field.Name: Routing
Field.Description: Behaviour of the Lit portion of a Dark-to-Lit sweep order. ignored when Routetolit = 0

Field.Name: LiqProv
Field.Description: Whether the order relates to liquidity provision activity

Field.Name: AlgoTradeFlag
Field.Description: Whether the order was generated by an algorithm

Field.Name: DEAFlag
Field.Description: Whether the order originates from a Direct Electronic Access client

Field.Name: lisOnly
Field.Description: LIS executions only; 0 = No restriction, 1 = LIS executions only

Field.Name: lis
Field.Description: LIS indicator set by the system

Field.Name: DarkFlag
Field.Description: Indicates if an order is a dark order

Field.Name: lis
Field.Description: LIS indicator set by the system; only valid when OrderType=12; 0 = Reference Price Waiver, 1 = Large in Scale

Field.Name: DarkFlag
Field.Description: Indicates if an order modify request was made for a dark order; 0 = No, 1 = Yes

Field.Name: reasonCode
Field.Description: Reason code if rejected or cancelled; otherwise zero

Field.Name: AlgoTradeFlag
Field.Description: Whether the order was generated by an algorithm; 0 = No, 1 = Yes

Field.Name: lis
Field.Description: Pre-trade transparency waiver; only valid when OrderType=12; 0 = Reference Price Waiver, 1 = Large in Scale

Field.Name: DarkFlag
Field.Description: Indicates whether a trade was executed on the dark order book; 0 = No, 1 = Yes
